mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.real_name AS handler_name FROM alarm_record a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.handler_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_record(target_type, target_id, target_name, metric, value, level, message, status) VALUES(#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{metric}, #{value}, #{level}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT level, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alarm_record GROUP BY level, status
